parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is a wooden wheel of the cart, circular in shape and attached to the axle for movement.
parts.Functional_description: The wheel allows the cart to roll smoothly and supports the load carried by the base body.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the axle to enable forward and backward motion of the cart.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the second wooden wheel of the cart, identical to the first one, providing balance and mobility.
parts.Functional_description: It works in tandem with the other wheel to maintain stability and allow the cart to move efficiently.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the same axle as the other wheel, ensuring synchronized motion.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main wooden body of the cart, including the handles and container area for carrying loads.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and supports the cargo, connects to the wheels, and provides handles for pushing or pulling.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheels, moving only when the entire cart is pushed or pulled.
